Flow.description: Creates a log record in the Audit Log if changes are detected in Account.

formulas.name: fAccountFieldsChanged_BasicLog
fChangedFieldsList
formulas.expression: TRIM( IF($Record.Active__c <> $Record__Prior.Active__c, "Active has been changed; ", "") & IF($Record.Active_TVM_Touchpoint_ID__c <> $Record__Prior.Active_TVM_Touchpoint_ID__c, "Active TVM Touchpoint ID has been changed; ", "") & IF($Record.Cancelled_Date__c <> $Record__Prior.Cancelled_Date__c, "Cancelled Date has been changed; ", "") & IF($Record.Client_Team__c <> $Record__Prior.Client_Team__c, "Client Team has been changed; ", "") & IF(TEXT($Record.Client_Type_Team_V__c) <> TEXT($Record__Prior.Client_Type_Team_V__c), "Client Type Team V has been changed; ", "") & IF($Record.Digital_SME__c <> $Record__Prior.Digital_SME__c, "Digital SME has been changed; ", "") & IF($Record.FNDN_Billed_Through_TVM__c <> $Record__Prior.FNDN_Billed_Through_TVM__c, "FNDN Billed Through TVM has been changed; ", "") & IF($Record.TVM_Billed_Through_FNDN__c <> $Record__Prior.TVM_Billed_Through_FNDN__c, "TVM Billed Through FNDN has been changed; ", "") )

formulas.name: fNewValuesText
formulas.expression:
TRIM( IF( $Record.Active__c <> $Record__Prior.Active__c, "Active: " & IF($Record.Active__c, "True", "False") & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.Active_TVM_Touchpoint_ID__c <> $Record__Prior.Active_TVM_Touchpoint_ID__c, "Active TVM Touchpoint ID: " & $Record.Active_TVM_Touchpoint_ID__c & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.Cancelled_Date__c <> $Record__Prior.Cancelled_Date__c, "Cancelled Date: " & IF(ISBLANK($Record.Cancelled_Date__c), "", TEXT($Record.Cancelled_Date__c)) & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.Website_Go_Live_Date__c <> $Record__Prior.Website_Go_Live_Date__c, "Website Go Live Date: " & IF(ISBLANK($Record.Website_Go_Live_Date__c), "", TEXT($Record.Website_Go_Live_Date__c)) & "; ", "" ) &
/* DateTime (New Value) */ IF( $Record.Generate_Contract_Profile__c <> $Record__Prior.Generate_Contract_Profile__c, "Generate Contract Profile: " & IF(ISBLANK($Record.Generate_Contract_Profile__c), "", TEXT($Record.Generate_Contract_Profile__c)) & "; ", "" ) &
IF( TEXT($Record.Client_Type_Team_V__c) <> TEXT($Record__Prior.Client_Type_Team_V__c), "Client Type Team V: " & TEXT($Record.Client_Type_Team_V__c) & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.FNDN_Billed_Through_TVM__c <> $Record__Prior.FNDN_Billed_Through_TVM__c, "FNDN Billed Through TVM: " & IF($Record.FNDN_Billed_Through_TVM__c, "True", "False") & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.TVM_Billed_Through_FNDN__c <> $Record__Prior.TVM_Billed_Through_FNDN__c, "TVM Billed Through FNDN: " & IF($Record.TVM_Billed_Through_FNDN__c, "True", "False") & "; ", "" ) &
/* Digital IDs (New Values) */ IF( $Record.Bing_ID__c <> $Record__Prior.Bing_ID__c, "Bing ID: " & $Record.Bing_ID__c & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.Google_CID__c <> $Record__Prior.Google_CID__c, "Google CID: " & $Record.Google_CID__c & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.Facebook_ID__c <> $Record__Prior.Facebook_ID__c, "Facebook ID: " & $Record.Facebook_ID__c & "; ", "" ) &
/* OEM Billing Info (New Values) */ IF( $Record.OEM_Dealer_Code__c <> $Record__Prior.OEM_Dealer_Code__c, "OEM Dealer Code: " & $Record.OEM_Dealer_Code__c & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.OEM_Region__c <> $Record__Prior.OEM_Region__c, "OEM Region: " & $Record.OEM_Region__c & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.OEM_Zone__c <> $Record__Prior.OEM_Zone__c, "OEM Zone: " & $Record.OEM_Zone__c & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.OEM_Serv__c <> $Record__Prior.OEM_Serv__c, "OEM Division Code: " & $Record.OEM_Serv__c & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.OEM_Service_Parts_Code__c <> $Record__Prior.OEM_Service_Parts_Code__c, "OEM Service Parts Code: " & $Record.OEM_Service_Parts_Code__c & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.Google_Payment_ID__c <> $Record__Prior.Google_Payment_ID__c, "Google Payment ID: " & $Record.Google_Payment_ID__c & "; ", "" ) &
IF( $Record.OwnerId<> $Record__Prior.OwnerId, "Owner ID: " & $Record.OwnerId& "; ", "" ) )

formulas.expression: SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( {!vNewValueText}, "Digital SME: SME: " & {!$Record.Digital_SME__c} & "; ", "Digital SME: " & {!Get_New_SME_User.Full_Name_Formula__c} & "; " ), "Digital SME: SME: " & {!$Record.Digital_SME__c} & ";", "Digital SME: " & {!Get_New_SME_User.Full_Name_Formula__c} & ";" ), "Digital SME: " & {!$Record.Digital_SME__c} & "; ", "Digital SME: " & {!Get_New_SME_User.Full_Name_Formula__c} & "; " ), "Digital SME: " & {!$Record.Digital_SME__c} & ";", "Digital SME: " & {!Get_New_SME_User.Full_Name_Formula__c} & ";" )

formulas.name: Parsed_Old_Value
formulas.expression: IF( CONTAINS({!MasterOldValue}, ":"), TRIM( SUBSTITUTE( MID( {!MasterOldValue}, FIND(":", {!MasterOldValue}) + 1, 9999 ), ";", "" ) ), TRIM(SUBSTITUTE({!MasterOldValue}, ";", "")) )
